title: sheaf
description: Sheaf: the glued settled structure — the base category and the settled section (a valuation at the knowledge-least fixed point). The output of settle; H¹ = 0 here. Every cell's charge is at equilibrium; the knowledge closure has quiesced.

base.description: The base category: objects and its four morphism slots.

section.description: The settled valuation: the base category plus the charged fiber-algebras at the fixed point.

fiber-algebras.description: The per-predicate fiber-algebras at the settled fixed point.
